Callout.Name: Poachers' Vehicle Found
Callout.Message: Vehicle left abandoned on a farm track.

Script.Line: It has been there three days. Nobody has come back for it.
The doors are open and the keys are in it.
There is blood in the back. Just so you know what you are walking up to.

Lines.Approach: Nobody with it, but there is lamping kit on the back seat. They will come back for it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
